notes.title: LOG: CREW INTERVIEW
notes.notes:
[h2][i]Excerpts from an interview with the crew of the experimental vessel Eisenblum from the Saturday issue of Wolf auf Wolf magazine.[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/eda9f6940a478c976c55e2dd53688e1b23b984e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/fb3ca73eb707bafc92747ae803ee79f863d816cc.png[/img]

[b]Athena Vesserschmidt, captain of the “Eisenblum”:[/b] I only take women on board on principle, but this time the staff sent me a guy named Maria. I still don’t know if it was a mistake or a joke, but we managed to work together. Oh, he did a great job, and the crew became so attached to him.

[b]Lucy Fokkel, turret operator (Bow): [/b]He is my commander. Of course, I treat him with respect, as required by the Charter [i][for unknown reasons, Lieutenant Commander Fokkel blushes - WaW] [/i]

[b]Rose Bells, Turret Operator (Left):[/b] Oh, during the flight, the commander has become our closest... friend! We value his... company so much. And we obey without question, right, Alice?

[b]Alice Catlass, Turret Operator (Right):[/b] Uh… yeah. We… treat him well.

[b]Maria Kamof, Turret Operator (Aft):[/b] Well… we made it on the “Eisenblum” at the same time, but I had no combat experience at all, and commander was kind enough to fill me in on the ins and outs of… fighting… I really appreciate his support!

[b]Lucio Sanchez, Mechanized Unit Commander:[/b] He’s fine. He can be useful sometimes. Especially when it comes to the galley.

[b]Сatarin Goranov, Communications Commander: [/b]He’s got a nice voice and fresh ideas, that’s all I can say… I haven’t even seen him once during the mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/0d6a8e67621670de4650bdaf4588d18c9b55adb0.png[/img]

[b]Athena Vesserschmidt, captain of the “Eisenblum”:[/b] Well, we usually go deep behind the lines… aggressively. Sturm und Drang, that sort of thing.

[b]Сatarin Goranov, Communications Commander: [/b]Yeah, we go behind the lines a lot… but you do realize that this is classified information, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/da1835796a116319ed5d220daa82bcf18b95fdb5.png[/img]

[b]Lucio Sanchez, Mechanized Unit Commander:[/b] Captain’s, definitely. She's got the organization to run this flying brothel and stay sane.
